answer_text:
Here is a roundup of some of the **best stocks to buy now in June 2026**, according to analysts and top investment research firms:

---

## 📈 Top Stocks to Buy – June 2026

### 1. 🚗 **Uber (UBER)**
Uber continues to benefit from steady demand in both ride-hailing and delivery. DA Davidson analyst Tom White kept a Buy rating and a $107 price target on Uber stock. Analysts have a Strong Buy consensus rating on Uber stock based on 27 Buys and two Holds, with an average price target of $105.96 per share, implying 43.07% upside potential.

---

### 2. ⚡ **Vistra Corp. (VST)**
Vistra is a major U.S. power producer benefiting from rising electricity demand tied to data centers, AI, and electrification. The company has been expanding its clean energy and battery storage assets while maintaining steady cash flow from its traditional power fleet. Jefferies analyst Julien Dumoulin Smith reiterated a Buy rating and a $212 target on Vistra stock, noting the stock now looks cheap after a 35% drop since late 2025.

---

### 3. ✈️ **Vertical Aerospace (EVTL)**
Vertical Aerospace is working on its VX4 aircraft, which aims to offer quiet, zero-emission urban flights. The company is making progress on testing, certification, and partnerships with airlines and travel operators. While still years from full commercial service, analysts believe EVTL offers long-term upside if electric aviation scales the way many expect. EVTL stock has a Strong Buy consensus rating based on four Buys and one Hold, with an average price target implying upside potential of 350.62%.

---

### 4. 🛒 **MercadoLibre (MELI)**
MercadoLibre is often referred to as the "Amazon of Latin America," operating an e-commerce marketplace with a dominant presence in some of the region's most populous nations, including Brazil and Argentina. It operates a fast-growing payments platform (Mercado Pago), a logistics service (Mercado Envios), a business lending platform, and more. The marketplace saw $19 billion in merchandise volume in Q1 2026, up 42% year-over-year.

---

### 5. 🏠 **Airbnb (ABNB)**
In Q1 2026, more than 156 million nights and experiences were booked on Airbnb's platform, with a total booking value of over $29 billion — 19% year-over-year growth. Airbnb is not only massive and growing quickly, but also highly profitable, generating $4.5 billion in free cash flow with a 36% FCF margin over the past 12 months. Looking forward, Airbnb has $12.1 billion in cash and short-term investments, and still has a massive growth opportunity with an overall market opportunity estimated to be in the trillions of dollars.

---

### 6. 🔬 **Vishay Precision Group (VPG)**
Vishay Precision Group's precision measurement and sensing technologies business is booming as it rides long-term megatrends across semiconductor equipment, data centers, avionics, military, and space. The firm is reaching a pivot point as its highly accurate sensors gain steam, with first-quarter bookings jumping 25.5% sequentially to $102.1 million — the third-highest quarterly level in VPG's history. Vishay Precision is projected to grow its adjusted earnings by 100% in 2026 and expand its bottom line by another 91% the following year.

---

## 🌍 Market Context
The stock market has been volatile in 2026 due to the Iran conflict, tariff uncertainty, and fears of a weakening economy. Although the S&P 500 is close to an all-time high, many stocks look extremely attractive for long-term investors.
